description: This file defines an abstract base class for checkpointing and two implementations: synchronous and asynchronous. It manages saving and loading model state dictionaries, with support for async operations, resource management, and external dependencies like checkpoint readers, writers, and staging components.

classes.name: Checkpointer
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the API for checkpointing, including save, load, and close methods.

classes.name: SyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Synchronous implementation of Checkpointer, coordinating checkpoint save/load operations without async overhead.

classes.name: AsyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Asynchronous implementation of Checkpointer, supporting staged and background checkpoint saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Abstract method to save a model state dictionary to storage, supporting sync and async variants.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Abstract method to load a model state dictionary from storage, with options for strictness and device mapping.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Abstract method to release resources associated with the checkpointer.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Synchronous method to save a checkpoint, delegating to the writer.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Synchronous method to load a checkpoint, delegating to the reader, with strict key checking.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronous method to stage and initiate checkpoint saving, returning futures.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Synchronous method to load a checkpoint in AsyncCheckpointer.
